segments.an9.6:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi … pe … āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca –
segments.an9.6:2.3: Cīvarampi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbaṃ – sevitabbampi asevitabbampi.
segments.an9.6:2.5: Piṇḍapātopi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopi.
segments.an9.6:2.7: Senāsanampi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbaṃ – sevitabbampi asevitabbampi.
segments.an9.6:2.9: Gāmanigamopi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopi.
segments.an9.6:2.11: Janapadapadesopi āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopi.
segments.an9.6:3.1: “‘Puggalopi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:3.5: ‘imaṃ kho me puggalaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti;
segments.an9.6:3.6: ye ca kho me pabbajitena jīvitaparikkhārā samudānetabbā cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārā te ca kasirena samudāgacchanti;
segments.an9.6:3.7: yassa camhi atthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito so ca me sāmaññattho na bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatī’ti, tenāvuso, puggalena so puggalo rattibhāgaṃ vā divasabhāgaṃ vā saṅkhāpi anāpucchā pakkamitabbaṃ nānubandhitabbo.
segments.an9.6:4.2: ‘imaṃ kho me puggalaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti;
segments.an9.6:4.3: ye ca kho me pabbajitena jīvitaparikkhārā samudānetabbā cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārā te ca appakasirena samudāgacchanti;
segments.an9.6:4.4: yassa camhi atthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito so ca me sāmaññattho na bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatī’ti, tenāvuso, puggalena so puggalo saṅkhāpi anāpucchā pakkamitabbaṃ nānubandhitabbo.
segments.an9.6:5.2: ‘imaṃ kho me puggalaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti;
segments.an9.6:5.3: ye ca kho me pabbajitena jīvitaparikkhārā samudānetabbā cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārā te ca kasirena samudāgacchanti;
segments.an9.6:5.4: yassa camhi atthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito so ca me sāmaññattho bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatī’ti, tenāvuso, puggalena so puggalo saṅkhāpi anubandhitabbo na pakkamitabbaṃ.
segments.an9.6:6.2: ‘imaṃ kho me puggalaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti;
segments.an9.6:6.3: ye ca kho me pabbajitena jīvitaparikkhārā samudānetabbā cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārā te ca appakasirena samudāgacchanti;
segments.an9.6:6.4: yassa camhi atthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito so ca me sāmaññattho bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatī’ti, tenāvuso, puggalena so puggalo yāvajīvaṃ anubandhitabbo na pakkamitabbaṃ api panujjamānena [paṇujjamānena (?)].
segments.an9.6:6.5: ‘Puggalopi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopī’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:7.1: “‘Cīvarampi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbaṃ – sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:7.5: ‘idaṃ kho me cīvaraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpaṃ cīvaraṃ na sevitabbaṃ.
segments.an9.6:7.7: ‘idaṃ kho me cīvaraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpaṃ cīvaraṃ sevitabbaṃ.
segments.an9.6:7.8: ‘Cīvarampi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbaṃ – sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:8.1: “‘Piṇḍapātopi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:8.5: ‘imaṃ kho me piṇḍapātaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpo piṇḍapāto na sevitabbo.
segments.an9.6:8.7: ‘imaṃ kho me piṇḍapātaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpo piṇḍapāto sevitabbo.
segments.an9.6:8.8: ‘Piṇḍapātopi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopī’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:9.1: “‘Senāsanampi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbaṃ – sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:9.5: “idaṃ kho me senāsanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpaṃ senāsanaṃ na sevitabbaṃ.
segments.an9.6:9.7: ‘idaṃ kho me senāsanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpaṃ senāsanaṃ sevitabbaṃ.
segments.an9.6:9.8: ‘Senāsanampi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbaṃ – sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:10.1: “‘Gāmanigamopi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:10.5: ‘imaṃ kho me gāmanigamaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpo gāmanigamo na sevitabbo.
segments.an9.6:10.7: ‘imaṃ kho, me gāmanigamaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpo gāmanigamo sevitabbo.
segments.an9.6:10.8: ‘Gāmanigamopi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopī’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:11.1: “‘Janapadapadesopi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.an9.6:11.5: ‘imaṃ kho me janapadapadesaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpo janapadapadeso na sevitabbo.
segments.an9.6:11.7: ‘imaṃ kho me janapadapadesaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpo janapadapadeso sevitabbo.
segments.an9.6:11.8: ‘Janapadapadesopi, āvuso, duvidhena veditabbo – sevitabbopi asevitabbopī’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttan”ti.

lines: Rattibhāgaṃ vā divasabhāgaṃ vāti ettha rattibhāge ñatvā rattibhāgeyeva pakkamitabbaṃ, rattiṃ caṇḍavāḷādiparipanthe sati aruṇuggamanaṃ āgametabbaṃ.
Divasabhāge ñatvā divā pakkamitabbaṃ, divā paripanthe sati sūriyatthaṅgamanaṃ āgametabbaṃ.
Anāpucchāti idha pana taṃ puggalaṃ anāpucchā pakkamitabbanti attho.
Evarūpo hi puggalo sacepi dārukalāpasataṃ vā udakaghaṭasataṃ vā vālikāghaṭasataṃ vā daṇḍaṃ āropeti, mā idha vasīti nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, taṃ khamāpetvāpi yāvajīvaṃ so anubandhitabbova, na vijahitabbo.
Te pana samudānitā samāhatā nāma hontīti āha “samāharitabbā”ti.
Rattibhāgaṃ vā divasabhāgaṃ vāti bhummatthe upayogavacananti āha “rattikoṭṭhāse vā divasakoṭṭhāse vā”ti.
Saṅkhāpīti “yadatthamahaṃ pabbajito, na metaṃ idha nipphajjati, cīvarādi pana samudāgacchati, nāhaṃ tadatthaṃ pabbajito, kiṃ me idha vāsenā”ti paṭisaṅkhāyapi.
So puggalo anāpucchā pakkamitabbaṃ, nānubandhitabboti “so puggalo”ti padassa “nānubandhitabbo”ti iminā sambandho.
Yassa yena hi sambandho, dūraṭṭhenapi so bhavati.
Taṃ puggalanti so puggaloti paccattavacanaṃ upayogavasena pariṇāmetvā taṃ puggalaṃ anāpucchā pakkamitabbanti attho.
Evarūpoti yaṃ nissāya bhikkhuno guṇehi vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā, paccayehi na parissayo, evarūpo daṇḍakammādīhi niggaṇhāti cepi, na pariccajitabboti dasseti “sacepī”tiādinā.
